description: This file contains Python source code for a JSON schema loader and parser, including classes for JSON types, objects, arrays, methods, and schema processing functions.

classes.name: JsonType
classes.description: Base class for JSON schema types, providing common properties and methods for handling schema definitions.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON object schema, managing properties, nested objects, and duplicate detection.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Represents a JSON array schema, managing item types and array-specific properties.

classes.name: JsonMethod
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC method schema, including parameters, results, and associated metadata.

classes.name: JsonNotification
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC notification schema, including notification-specific properties.

classes.name: JsonCallback
classes.description: Represents a callback schema associated with notifications.

classes.name: JsonProperty
classes.description: Represents a property within a JSON object schema, including access modifiers and endpoint names.

classes.name: JsonRpcSchema
classes.description: Represents the entire JSON-RPC schema, including interface info, methods, and included schemas.

classes.name: JsonItem
classes.description: Factory function that creates specific JSON schema type objects based on schema definitions.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the global logger object for logging issues and information.

methods.name: Tstring
methods.description: Returns a string formatted with '_T("%s")' for localization or translation purposes.

methods.name: Scoped
methods.description: Generates a scoped name for a JSON object or enum, considering hierarchy and namespace.

methods.name: CoreJson
methods.description: Constructs a core JSON type string with a prefix from configuration.

methods.name: CoreError
methods.description: Generates a core error string with a prefix.

methods.name: MakeObject
methods.description: Creates a standardized object type name with suffix.

methods.name: MakeEnum
methods.description: Creates a standardized enum type name with suffix.

methods.name: LoadSchema
methods.description: Loads and processes a JSON schema file, resolving references and includes.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Main entry point to load schemas from a file, handling header files and JSON schemas.
